Choose a dish, shop for its ingredients and prepare the food. Follow the game's on-screen prompt to start the serving activity.
en.aboutTitle: Making a dish from shopping to livestream

hi.summary: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang में सामग्री खरीदें, डिश बनाएँ और लाइवस्ट्रीम में परोसें।
about: खरीदने से पहले तय करें क्या परोसना है। उस डिश की सामग्री देखें और पहले वही लें। सब तैयार हो तो पकाने के चरण अपनाएँ और देखें खेल किस औज़ार या सामग्री को दिखा रहा है।
काम का क्रम समझ आए तो दूसरी डिश आज़माएँ। देखें दुकान या रसोई में क्या बदलता है, फिर जो बनाया है उसी से लाइव पूरा करें।
steps: डिश चुनें और सामग्री लें
पकवान चुनें और उसकी ज़रूरी सामग्री खरीदें।
खाना बनाकर लाइव जाएँ
खाना तैयार करें और बने पकवान से लाइवस्ट्रीम गतिविधि पूरी करें।
faq: मुकबैंग लाइवस्ट्रीम से पहले क्या करना है?
डिश चुनें, उसकी सामग्री खरीदें और खाना बनाएँ। परोसने के लिए स्क्रीन का संकेत अपनाएँ।
hi.aboutTitle: खरीदारी से लाइव तक डिश बनाएँ

en.summary: Guide an arrow through narrow passages in Geometry: Black Wave. Pick a difficulty and use the music to remember where to prepare for a tight turn.
about: Use the music as a cue for a turn, then look at how much room the passage gives you. If you keep clipping a narrow gap, enter the wide section just before it at a different height and use a smaller adjustment.

If a narrow section keeps stopping you, find the last wide space before it. Start the next attempt by placing your arrow in a better position there. That can leave you less to correct once the walls close in.
steps: Check the level difficulty
Select a level and check its difficulty marker.
Time your direction changes
Time the arrow’s movement through narrow gaps and stay clear of obstacles.
faq: How do I choose a gentler Black Wave level?
Look at the difficulty marker before you start. Learn the response to short inputs on that course, then take the same timing into a tighter level.
en.aboutTitle: Reading the turns in a Black Wave level

hi.summary: Geometry: Black Wave में संगीत के साथ तीर को रुकावटों से निकालें। कठिनाई चुनें और सँकरे रास्ते पर हल्का दबाना सीखें।
about: मुश्किल मोड़ कब आएगा यह याद रखने के लिए ताल सुनें और नज़र रास्ते के आकार पर रखें। दो ताल एक जैसी सुन सकती हैं लेकिन आगे की जगह अलग चौड़ी हो सकती है।
तंग हिस्सा बार-बार रोक रहा है तो उससे पहले की आखिरी चौड़ी जगह देखें। अगली बार वहीं तीर सही जगह रखें। दीवारें पास आने पर दिशा कम सुधारनी पड़ेगी।
steps: स्तर की कठिनाई देखें
स्तर चुनें और उसकी कठिनाई का संकेत देखें।
दिशा बदलने का समय चुनें
तंग जगहों में सही समय पर तीर चलाएँ और बाधाओं से बचें।
faq: Black Wave का आसान स्तर कैसे चुनें?
शुरू करने से पहले कठिनाई का निशान देखें। वहाँ छोटे दबाव का असर सीखकर बाद में तंग स्तर पर जाएँ।
hi.aboutTitle: Black Wave के स्तर में मोड़ पहचानें

en.summary: Choose an animal and give it a hairstyle in Animal Hair Salon. Pick your tools along the bottom and try accessories once the main shape is finished.
about: Pick an animal and decide what you want to change about its hairstyle. Use the first tool on one section, then look at the shape from end to end before choosing an accessory or another tool.

An accessory can sit differently on a short or a long style. Finish the main shape first and try decorations in different spots. The same animal can have a different look with just a change of parting or accessory.
steps: Pick an animal and a tool
Choose an animal and select a tool along the bottom of the screen.
Shape the hair and add accessories
Use the tool on the hair, then pick accessories to finish the look.
faq: Where do I find the tools in Animal Hair Salon?
Pick them from the bottom of the screen and use them on the hair. Switch tools when the part you are working on is ready.
en.aboutTitle: Choosing a style for each animal

hi.summary: Animal Hair Salon में जानवरों के बाल सजाएँ। जानवर चुनें, नीचे के औज़ार आज़माएँ और आखिर में सजावट लगाएँ।
about: जानवर चुनें और औज़ार लेने से पहले उसके बालों का आकार देखें। तय करें पहले कौन-सा हिस्सा बदलना है। एक हिस्सा होने पर दूसरा औज़ार लेने से पहले पूरा चेहरा देखें।
एक ही सजावट छोटे और लंबे बालों पर अलग बैठती है। पहले मुख्य आकार तैयार करें, फिर अलग जगह सजावट लगाकर देखें। माँग या गहना बदलने से उसी जानवर का रूप बदल सकता है।
steps: जानवर और औज़ार चुनें
जानवर चुनें और स्क्रीन के नीचे से उपकरण लें।
बालों का आकार बनाकर सजाएँ
बालों पर उपकरण इस्तेमाल करें, फिर रूप पूरा करने के लिए सजावट चुनें।
faq: Animal Hair Salon के औज़ार कहाँ हैं?
स्क्रीन के नीचे से चुनें और बालों पर इस्तेमाल करें। मौजूदा हिस्सा तैयार हो जाए तो औज़ार बदलें।
hi.aboutTitle: हर जानवर के लिए हेयरस्टाइल चुनें

title: Epic Sword Battle! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!

en.summary: Play ragdoll sword duels in Epic Sword Battle. Watch how far your fighter can reach and make space in the arena after a missed swing.
about: Watch the sword’s movement in the game before making your character attack. If the swing misses, check how far apart the fighters ended up. Reset your position before pressing the attack again.
If you keep missing at the same range, take a shorter step in before swinging. If you are trading hits, wait for a clearer opening rather than attacking twice from the same position.
steps: Face the opponent and check the distance
Move your fighter around the arena and face the opponent.
Time the swing and recover
Attack with your sword and fend off return strikes to win the duel.
faq: What should I do after missing a swing?
Check how close the opponent has moved. Get space to recover, then line up a closer or better-timed strike.
en.aboutTitle: Finding an opening in a ragdoll sword duel

hi.summary: Epic Sword Battle में पुतलों की तलवारबाज़ी खेलें। तलवार की पहुँच पहचानें, मौका देखकर वार करें और फिर दूरी बनाएँ।
about: इतना दूर रहें कि विरोधी का अगला वार दिखाई दे। उसकी तलवार निकल जाए तो तभी पास जाएँ जब आपकी तलवार पहुँच सके। वार के बाद हटने के लिए अपने किरदार की चाल भी देखें।
एक ही दूरी से वार खाली जा रहा हो तो पहले थोड़ा पास जाएँ। दोनों को साथ चोट लग रही हो तो उसी जगह दोबारा वार करने से पहले बेहतर मौका देखें।
steps: सामने देखकर दूरी जाँचें
अखाड़े में योद्धा चलाएँ और विरोधी की ओर मुँह करें।
सही समय पर वार करके पीछे हटें
तलवार से वार करें और जवाबी हमले रोककर मुकाबला जीतें।
faq: वार खाली जाए तो क्या करूँ?
देखें विरोधी कितना पास आ गया है। सँभलने की जगह बनाएँ और अगला वार कम दूरी या सही समय से करें।
hi.aboutTitle: तलवार की लड़ाई में वार का मौका

en.summary: Time your drive with one shot control in Golf Orbit. Watch where the ball first lands to see whether the timing or the bounce added distance.
about: Watch the timing cue through a full pass, then pick a spot on it for your shot. Keep the same reference point when you play again. Compare where the ball first touches down as well as where it stops.

If you keep hitting short, change the timing slightly on the next attempt. Watch where the ball first lands as well as the final distance. That makes it easier to tell whether a better launch or the bounce made the difference.
steps: Watch the shot indicator
Use the single shot control and watch the timing cue.
Compare the landing after the shot
Release at the intended moment and try to improve the distance on your next shot.
faq: Do I need several buttons to hit the ball?
Golf Orbit uses one shot control. Focus on the timing cue and compare small changes between attempts.
en.aboutTitle: Timing a long drive in Golf Orbit

hi.summary: Golf Orbit में गेंद सबसे दूर मारें। एक बटन वाले संकेत का समय पकड़ें और देखें हर शॉट कहाँ उतरता है।
about: मारने से पहले संकेत को एक बार पूरा चलते देखें। सबसे अच्छे हिस्से के पास एक निशान चुनें और उसी समय बटन दबाएँ। उसी सेटअप से फिर देखें नतीजा कितना मिलता है।
गेंद बार-बार कम दूर जा रही हो तो अगली कोशिश में समय थोड़ा बदलें। कुल दूरी के साथ पहली बार गेंद कहाँ गिरी, यह भी देखें। तब समझ आएगा कि फ़र्क शुरुआत से पड़ा या उछाल से।
steps: शॉट का निशान देखें

खुले रास्ते वाले तीर टैप करें और घन खाली करें।

Look in the panel on the right.

When no exposed card fits, draw from the deck and check the peaks again.

Harvest lemons and use your earnings to improve or expand production.

Use the right side of the screen to control the camera.

en.summary: Launch cartoon pets at buildings and bring each structure down before your charges run out.

about: Launch cartoon pets at buildings and bring each structure down before your charges run out.

Click or tap a weak-looking spot on the building to launch a pet.

Check the building’s health bar at the top of the screen.

en.summary: Drop matching monsters together while keeping the pile below the top line.

about: Drop matching monsters together while keeping the pile below the top line.

Move the next monster above a matching piece, then drop it.
Keep below the top line
Merge identical monsters and spread the pile to keep the top line clear.

The round ends when the pile crosses the top line.

en.summary: Roll a small slime around a planet, swallowing objects as it grows larger.
en.aboutTitle: About Slime Planet Eater
about: Roll a small slime around a planet, swallowing objects as it grows larger.
At first only small objects fit. Follow a route with several easy pickups, then return for bigger objects once the slime has grown.
steps: Steer the slime
Steer by dragging or by using WASD or the arrow keys.
Grow on smaller objects
Roll into objects smaller than your slime to absorb them.
faq: Do I need a button to eat something?
No. Contact is enough if the object is small enough.

en.summary: Match numbered domino ends and try to empty your hand before the round is blocked.

Choose a tile whose end matches one open end on the table.
Play until the round ends
Play until one player uses all their tiles or neither can move.

Each player starts with seven tiles.

en.summary: Fit shapes onto the grid and clear complete rows or columns to make space.
en.aboutTitle: About QBlock Puzzle
about: Fit shapes onto the grid and clear complete rows or columns to make space.
Large or awkward pieces are harder to place once the board breaks into narrow gaps. Check where they fit before filling a nearly complete line.

Drag a block from the tray onto a free section of the board.
Clear a row or column
Complete a row or column to clear it and earn points.
faq: When does a round end?
It ends when you cannot place an available block.

en.searchTitle: Papa Cherry Saga – Match 3 Candy Puzzle Online
en.summary: Play Papa Cherry Saga online. Match cookies and sweets, make striped cookies and guide gingerbread pieces to the bottom of the board.
en.aboutTitle: Match sweets and clear a path for gingerbread
about: Papa Cherry Saga is a match-3 puzzle with cookies, marshmallows and chocolate. Check each level’s goal before you swap pieces. Some levels ask you to collect particular sweets, while others ask you to bring gingerbread down to the bottom.

Drag one piece toward another to match three or more identical pieces in a row or column.
Clear space under gingerbread
On levels with gingerbread, match pieces below it to bring it closer to the bottom. Use a vertical Striped Cookie when you need to clear much of a column.
faq: How do I make a Rainbow Bomb?
Match five identical pieces in a straight row or column.

en.summary: Finish the answers in a cartoon classroom before the bell without being spotted by the teacher.
en.aboutTitle: About Cheat and Don't Get Caught!
about: Finish the answers in a cartoon classroom before the bell without being spotted by the teacher.
The teacher’s attention determines when it is safe to look. Switch away from the phone before the teacher looks in your direction.
steps: Check the answers
Use the on-screen buttons to check the answers and write them down.
Watch the teacher
Hide the phone when the teacher turns, then choose an upgrade after the day.
faq: What should I watch while the phone is open?
Watch the teacher so you know when to hide the phone.

en.summary: Steer through street courses, stay on the road and work through the available tracks.
en.aboutTitle: About Street Race Master
about: Steer through street courses, stay on the road and work through the available tracks.
Start with small corrections through bends. A late move across the track gives you less room to handle the next turn.
steps: Steer your car
Move the car left or right with the mouse or by touch.
Follow the curves
Follow the track and adjust early when the road curves.
faq: What controls do I use on mobile?
Use touch to steer left and right.

en.summary: Test cars on downhill roads, dirt tracks and jumps, then repair them for another run.
en.aboutTitle: About Realistic Car Destruction Sandbox

steps: Drive a test route
Choose a vehicle and environment, then drive with WASD or the arrow keys.
Boost, brake or repair
Use Space for the handbrake, Left Shift for boost and R to repair.
faq: Can I repair the car without starting over?
Yes. Press R on a keyboard to repair it.

en.summary: Grow a small airstrip into a busy airport by upgrading aircraft and terminal facilities.
en.aboutTitle: About Idle Airport Tycoon
about: Grow a small airstrip into a busy airport by upgrading aircraft and terminal facilities.
Compare upgrades before spending your income. Improving the existing airport and opening a new revenue stream give you different ways to expand.

Click the in-game controls to manage the airport and buy upgrades.
Adjust the camera
Use the plus and minus keys to change the camera zoom as the airport expands.
faq: What can I upgrade?
The game offers upgrades for aircraft and terminal facilities, among others.

Work together to survive
Work with the group toward rescues and achievements while surviving the nights.

Money found or earned can be spent on character and achievement unlocks.

en.summary: Inspect restaurant customers and decide which visitors are robots in disguise.

Inspect the visitor with your mouse or by touch.
Decide who enters
Decide who to let in and who to turn away.

Check the telltale signs introduced in the tutorial before deciding.

Tap or click a slime to send it around the loop.
Reuse parked slimes
Relaunch parked slimes when there are reachable pixels in their color.

It shows how many shots the slime has left.

Move through the starting area and use the game’s power-building activities.
Retry the obstacle
Return to a harder obstacle after raising your power.

Build more power before trying it again.

Press and drag through neighboring letters to trace a word.
Submit and continue
Release to submit the word, then work through the remaining tiles.

No. Paths can bend around corners.

en.summary: Catch fish by moving over them, earn coins and unlock upgrades and new fish.

Spend coins on upgrades, and check the tasks for extra rewards.

Earn enough prestige points, then hold the prestige button.

Divide the scene into smaller regions and check them in order.

Merge matching heroes when they are available.

Finish one color at a time while keeping space to move the rest.

The top colors must match unless the destination is completely empty.

Hold and drag to rotate the model until that side is visible.

Add related words until the group has four members.

en.aboutTitle: About DOP2: Draw Love
about: Look at each scene and draw its missing detail to solve the puzzle.
The surroundings tell you what belongs in the blank space. Think about which object would complete the action, not how to make the drawing look polished.
steps: Read the scene
Inspect the people and objects in the scene for clues.
Draw the missing detail
Draw the outline of the missing detail in the spot where it belongs.
faq: What should I try if the drawing is not accepted?
Recheck the missing object and try a clearer outline in the intended location.

en.summary: Place dice on a grid and merge groups that show the same face.
en.aboutTitle: About Dice Puzzle
about: Place dice on a grid and merge groups that show the same face.
A pair may fit better after rotation. Look for places where matching faces touch along an edge, not just at a corner.
steps: Rotate and place dice
Tap to rotate a die or pair before dragging it onto the board.
Merge matching faces
Put three or more matching faces next to each other horizontally or vertically.
faq: Can I rotate a pair before placing it?
Yes. Tap it in the tray to change its orientation.

en.summary: Run a supermarket by keeping items stocked and serving customers.
en.aboutTitle: About Supermarket Empire
about: Run a supermarket by keeping items stocked and serving customers.
Pay attention to where shoppers are waiting and which work needs doing first. Short trips help keep the checkout and shelves from falling behind.
steps: Move through the store
Use WASD, arrow keys or a mouse drag to move around the store.
Stock shelves and serve
Restock products and go to the customers who are ready to be served.
faq: How do I move if I prefer a mouse?
Hold the left mouse button and drag.

en.summary: Break asteroids, collect resources and spend coins and skill points on improvements.
en.aboutTitle: About Feeding A Black Hole
about: Break asteroids, collect resources and spend coins and skill points on improvements.
Damage upgrades help with tougher targets, while new asteroid types and abilities add choices. Leveling up also lets you pick a bonus.
steps: Break asteroids
Move your cursor or finger across asteroids to break them.
Spend your resources
Spend the resources you earn on damage, new targets or abilities.
faq: What happens when I level up?
You can pick one of three randomly offered bonuses.

en.summary: Group identical skewers on the same grill to complete orders and clear space.
en.aboutTitle: About BBQ Sort
about: Group identical skewers on the same grill to complete orders and clear space.
A grill with room gives you somewhere to move a skewer temporarily. Check which trio you can finish before moving several unrelated pieces.
steps: Move a skewer
Tap a skewer and move it to a grill with room.
Complete an order
Gather three identical skewers on one grill to clear the order.
faq: How many skewers complete an order?
Three identical skewers on the same grill.

en.summary: Explore the map, discover pets and ride them on the ground or in the air.
en.aboutTitle: About Pet Riders
about: Explore the map, discover pets and ride them on the ground or in the air.
Use the map to choose where to go and the pets menu to check your collection. Flying adds separate controls for rising and descending.
steps: Explore with your pet
Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use E to interact on desktop.
Rise, descend or dismount
While flying, use Space to rise and Shift to descend. Press R to dismount.
faq: How do I open the pets menu on desktop?
Press B. Use M for the map.

en.summary: Collect neon food, grow your snake and compete for points in a cyberpunk arena.
en.aboutTitle: About Snake 2077: Glitch War
about: Collect neon food, grow your snake and compete for points in a cyberpunk arena.
If another snake falls, its remains add to your score. Avoid cutting too close to a rival when you do not have room to turn.
steps: Grow on neon food
Steer toward food to grow longer.
Use a speed boost
Use the boost when you have enough room to maneuver around a rival.
faq: What does boosting cost?
It spends some of your mass to give you a burst of speed.

en.summary: Rebuild a scrambled image by swapping tiles in themed collections or the daily puzzle.
en.aboutTitle: About Jigsolitaire Puzzle
about: Rebuild a scrambled image by swapping tiles in themed collections or the daily puzzle.
Start with a distinctive object or a corner. Once it is in place, use it as a reference for the pieces next to it.
steps: Swap two tiles
Drag one tile onto another to swap them.
Rebuild the picture
Keep swapping until every tile is in the position that completes the picture.
faq: Is there a separate daily board?
Yes. Choose Daily Puzzle for the daily image.

en.summary: Draw the symbols above ghosts to help Momo protect her school.
en.aboutTitle: About Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Academy
about: Draw the symbols above ghosts to help Momo protect her school.
Read the symbols in order when a ghost carries more than one. Prioritize the ghost that is closest instead of waiting for a larger group.
steps: Draw the first symbol
Use your mouse or finger to draw the shape over an approaching ghost’s head as shown.
Complete the sequence
Draw multi-symbol sequences in order before the ghost reaches Momo.
faq: How do I defeat a ghost with several symbols?
Draw each of its symbols in order.

en.summary: Draw a way home for each character while avoiding enemies and obstacles.
en.aboutTitle: About Draw path to home
about: Draw a way home for each character while avoiding enemies and obstacles.
Look at the destination and any moving dangers before drawing. A path with more clearance is often better than the shortest line.
steps: Start at a character
Click or tap the character to start a route.
Avoid obstacles on the way home
Draw the route to the house, going around anything unsafe.
faq: Do I need to take the shortest route?
No. Avoiding obstacles and reaching the house safely matters first.

en.summary: Match free tiles in classic Mahjong Solitaire across daily boards, a journey mode and free play.
en.aboutTitle: About Mahjong Tide
about: Match free tiles in classic Mahjong Solitaire across daily boards, a journey mode and free play.
Look for pairs that uncover tiles below them or free up a blocked side. Quick matches can extend a chain, but opening the board matters more.
steps: Select two free tiles
Select two matching tiles that are uncovered and have at least one open side.
Remove the remaining pairs
Keep removing pairs until the board is clear. Use a hint or undo if you get stuck.
faq: Do flower tiles need identical art?
No. Any two flowers match, and any two seasons match.

en.summary: Choose tackle, cast into different waters and land fish without breaking the line.
en.aboutTitle: About Lovim: Fishing Simulator 3D
about: Choose tackle, cast into different waters and land fish without breaking the line.
Weather and the bite forecast affect what is active. Use the map to check depth and try another fishing spot if the current one is quiet.
steps: Cast and set the hook
Hold the mouse button or Cast control to charge a cast, then release. Press Strike when a fish bites.
Reel in the fish
Hold Reel to fight the fish and ease the drag when the line is under too much tension.
faq: Where can I check water depth?
Open the map to see depth and move to other waters.

en.searchTitle: Christmas Girls Dress Up – Holiday Fashion Game
en.summary: Play Christmas Girls Dress Up online. Style four friends in gingerbread, Nutcracker, Santa and Grinch looks with holiday outfits and accessories.
en.aboutTitle: Style four Christmas outfits
about: Christmas Girls Dress Up gives four friends a different festive look each. Dress a gingerbread cutie, put together a Nutcracker outfit, or style the other two friends around Santa and the Grinch.
Start with a dress or a top, then try different hairstyles, shoes and accessories to finish each outfit.
steps: Pick a friend and browse her wardrobe
Click on desktop or tap on mobile to open the clothing and accessory categories.
Build the outfit
Choose clothes and shoes, then finish the look with a hairstyle and accessories that fit her Christmas theme.
faq: What are the four dress-up themes?
The four looks are inspired by gingerbread, the Nutcracker, Santa and the Grinch.

en.searchTitle: Catch the Snowmen! – Christmas Snowman Game
en.summary: Play Catch the Snowmen! online. Gather presents to recruit snowmen, avoid stronger enemies and earn ornaments to decorate your Christmas tree.
en.aboutTitle: Build a snowman team and decorate the tree
about: Every gift you collect in Catch the Snowmen! can help grow your snowman team. Watch enemy levels as you move around the map. Pick fights with weaker enemies and steer clear of stronger groups until you are ready.
Finish levels to earn ornaments for the Christmas tree and improve your team. You can also collect magical items to prepare for tougher bosses.
steps: Move toward gifts
Use WASD or the arrow keys on desktop. On a phone, touch the screen to bring up the virtual joystick.
Check enemy levels
Approach enemies below your level. If a stronger enemy gets close, move away and collect more gifts before returning.
faq: How do I get Christmas tree ornaments?
Complete levels to earn toys you can hang on the tree.

title: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro!

en.searchTitle: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro – Christmas Co-op
en.summary: Play Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro solo or with a friend on one device. Throw snowballs, win mini-games and upgrade your Christmas tree.
en.aboutTitle: Grow a Christmas tree with a friend
about: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro is a Christmas arcade game with solo play and local co-op. Win mini-games to earn Bucks for growing the tree and collect gifts to buy decorations.
Try snowball targets, house deliveries and the challenge where you catch falling Bucks while dodging bombs. Combine items to craft ornaments for your tree.
steps: Share a keyboard
Player 1 uses A, S and D to move, W to jump and Q to act. Player 2 uses Left, Down and Right to move, Up to jump and Enter to act.
Play mini-games and upgrade the tree
Spend Bucks to grow the tree and use gifts to buy more ornaments.
faq: Can two people play on one computer?
Yes. Local co-op lets each player control a character on the same screen and keyboard.

en.searchTitle: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party – Dress-Up Game
en.summary: Play Fashionista Christmas Eve Party online. Try festive outfits and accessories and put together a look for a Christmas Eve celebration.
en.aboutTitle: Put together a Christmas Eve party outfit
about: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party is a holiday dress-up game where you choose the outfit and accessories for a festive party look.
Try different outfit and accessory combinations. Start with the piece you like most and see which accessories work with it before settling on the final look.
steps: Choose a party outfit
Click an outfit with the left mouse button on desktop or tap it on mobile.
Add accessories
Select accessories to go with the outfit. You can revisit your choices as you try different looks.
faq: How do I select an outfit on mobile?
Tap the clothing item or accessory you want to try.

en.searchTitle: Santa Stunt Racer Christmas Delivery – Racing Game
en.summary: Drive Santa’s car over snowy ramps, collect Christmas gifts and reach the finish line. Unlock vehicles with different speed and handling.
en.aboutTitle: Deliver presents on snowy stunt tracks
about: Santa Stunt Racer Christmas Delivery puts gifts along ramps and obstacle courses. Pick them up as you drive Santa’s car toward the finish, where the children are waiting.
A fast, clean run improves your delivery score. Time your approach to jumps so you can land ready for the next ramp. New vehicles have different handling and speed.
steps: Drive Santa’s car
Use WASD or the arrow keys. Line up the car before going over a ramp or around an obstacle.
Collect gifts and finish the track
Grab the presents along the route and cross the finish line to deliver them.
faq: What improves my delivery score?
Finish the course quickly and cleanly while picking up the Christmas gifts along the way.

en.searchTitle: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater – Design Game
en.summary: Design ugly Christmas sweaters online. Choose colors, add reindeer, bows and lights, then style three friends for their holiday party.
en.aboutTitle: Design three ugly Christmas sweaters
about: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater lets you pick a sweater color and cover it with Christmas decorations. Try reindeer, snowmen or trees, then fill in the design with lights and bows.
Create a different sweater for each of the three friends. Finish their party looks with hairstyles and accessories that go with the sweaters.
steps: Pick a sweater color
Click or tap to select a base color for the friend you’re styling.
Decorate it for the party
Choose Christmas patterns and ornaments, then complete the look with a hairstyle and accessories.
faq: What can I put on the sweaters?
Decorations include Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, lights and bows.

en.searchTitle: Santa Holiday Adventure Game – 3D Sleigh Adventure
en.summary: Fly Santa’s sleigh through snowy villages in this 3D Christmas game. Deliver presents before sunrise and collect coins for reindeer and upgrades.
en.aboutTitle: Fly Santa’s sleigh before sunrise
about: Santa Holiday Adventure Game is a 3D Christmas arcade game. Fly over snowy villages, collect coins and help Santa finish his gift deliveries before morning.
Keep an eye on the time as you go from home to home. Coins help you get new reindeer, sleigh upgrades and boosters for later missions.
steps: Follow the gift delivery route
Use the on-screen controls to guide Santa’s sleigh through the village and reach the homes on your route.
Collect coins along the way
Use coins to unlock reindeer, sleigh upgrades and boosters for later deliveries.
faq: What are coins used for?
Spend coins on sleigh upgrades, new reindeer and boosters.

en.searchTitle: Santa Gift Delivery Christmas Game – Play Online
en.summary: Steer Santa’s sleigh through a snowy city in Santa Gift Delivery Christmas Game. Dodge traffic, deliver presents and collect coins for upgrades.
en.aboutTitle: Steer Santa’s sleigh through winter traffic
about: Santa Gift Delivery Christmas Game takes you through snowy city routes with traffic and other obstacles in your path. Guide the reindeer-powered sleigh past them while making deliveries.
Ease off the speed when the route gets crowded. Collect coins when the path is clear and use them to upgrade your sleigh or get new reindeer.
steps: Control your speed and direction
On a keyboard, press Up to accelerate and Down to brake. Use Left and Right to steer.
Dodge obstacles
Steer away from traffic and hazards. On a touchscreen, swipe left or right to move out of their way.
faq: How do I steer on a phone?
Swipe left or right to move the sleigh and avoid obstacles.

en.searchTitle: Palkovil The Way Home – Christmas Adventure Game
en.summary: Play Palkovil The Way Home online. Explore a mysterious lab, solve puzzles and collect toys as you try to bring the Christmas tree home.
en.aboutTitle: Bring the Christmas tree home
about: Palkovil The Way Home is a Christmas adventure set in a laboratory. Explore its rooms, solve riddles and help the aliens with their tasks as you work to bring the tree home.
Look at the paintings for collectible cards and turn on the lights in rooms you need to access. You’ll encounter animals to feed, toys to collect and bosses to face along the way.
steps: Explore the laboratory
Switch on the lights in the right rooms. Look at paintings and objects for clues as you move through the lab.
Complete tasks for the aliens
Follow their requests to earn toys and make progress toward bringing back the Christmas tree.
faq: How do I get toys in Palkovil?
Complete tasks for the aliens as you explore the lab.

en.searchTitle: Kitty Kitty – Cozy Winter Cat Game
en.summary: Play Kitty Kitty online. Care for cats in a snowy Christmas setting, collect cat food and raise their Sweetness in this cozy idle game.
en.aboutTitle: Care for cats in a snowy Christmas setting
about: Kitty Kitty is an idle cat-care game with Santa hats, decorated trees and snowmen. Collect cat food to level up your cats and raise their Sweetness.
Check in for daily rewards or visit Challenges to see which tasks you can complete. The bottom menu takes you to the Toy Room, food bowl, Kitty Wiki and recycling.
steps: Collect cat food
Click or tap the food and resource icons. Use the food you collect to level up your cats.
Claim rewards and explore
Open Check In for daily rewards or Challenges for tasks. Use the bottom icons to move between the play areas and menus.
faq: What is cat food used for?
Cat food is the main resource for leveling up your cats and raising their Sweetness.
